column2: The inside wall of a new Manhattan skyscraper lobby: slatted warm oak panels, a long black building directory with white letters listing floors in a wide grid, brushed steel trim, a strip of soft LED light along the top, a giant hand drawn marker doodle of a cloud above a mound of dirt painted directly on the wall.

The wall of a wine store basement stockroom: floor to ceiling steel shelving stacked with hundreds of cardboard wine cases with blank labels and stencilled numbers, a few wooden crates, a hand written cardboard sign, a fire extinguisher, a bare fluorescent tube, concrete block wall behind.

The wall of a wine shop's video set in 2006: wooden wine racks full of bottles floor to ceiling, a shelf of VHS tapes with hand written labels, a green football pennant, a cheap wall clock, a corkboard pinned with photos of flower headed people, a whiteboard with a tally of episodes.

The wall of a loft boxing gym crossed with a library: tall oak bookshelves packed with hardback books with blank spines in red, navy and black, framed fight posters with flower headed boxers, a speed bag mounted on a board, a row of boxing gloves on hooks, exposed brick between the shelves.

The wall of a creative agency's open office: a run of giant glass whiteboards covered in marker doodles, flow charts, sticky notes in yellow and pink, a hand drawn pyramid diagram, a wall of framed campaign posters with flower headed people, an exposed concrete column, a neon strip, a Manhattan window at the edge.

The wall of a podcast studio: black acoustic foam panels in a wedge pattern, pink and blue LED tube lights, a grid of twenty glowing smartphones on a black mount showing vertical videos of flower headed people, a framed gold record with a flower, a neon sign that says VEE.

The street level facade of a grand Park Avenue limestone apartment building at dusk: tall lit windows with ornate stone frames, a green canopy over the entrance with a doorman in uniform with a flower head, brass lanterns, carved stone garlands, planters with tulips at the base.

The inner wall panels of a historic carousel pavilion: hand painted rounding boards with oval landscape paintings of Central Park, gold scrollwork, rows of warm carnival bulbs, mirrored panels, painted wooden horses in profile mid gallop in red, white and gold, small painted name plates that say VEE and MLOW.

The wall of a packed indoor arena seen from the stage: tier after tier of seats full of a cheering crowd with flower heads under pink and blue light, raised phones glowing, confetti in the air, a LED ribbon band running across the tiers showing a cartoon cloud and a mound of dirt in a loop.

The wall of screens on an exchange floor: a dense grid of large monitors showing jagged line charts in green and red, bar charts, scrolling tickers with numbers, short labels like SHORT VIDEO, PODCAST, NEWSLETTER, LIVE and STREET, a big central board that says ATTENTION, brass rail at the bottom.

The wall of a football stadium's luxury suite level: dark green padded panels, framed vintage photographs of players with flower heads, a marble bar counter with bottles, a long window onto the green floodlit field and the crowd in green and white, a brass sign that says N3W.

A wall of sky at sunrise: bands of golden and pink cumulus clouds seen from above, deep blue sky at the top, the tops of a few Manhattan spires breaking through the clouds along the bottom, birds in silhouette, soft light.
